events.label: Diffusion probabilistic models
events.blurb: Sohl-Dickstein et al. invert a gradual noising process; the founding idea.

events.label: NAT
events.blurb: One-pass parallel translation; names the multimodality problem that still governs parallel decoding.

events.label: Iterative refinement
events.blurb: Lee et al. frame refinement as conditional denoising, the score connection avant la lettre.

events.label: Mask-Predict
events.blurb: Masked LM training + re-mask-the-least-confident decoding: the modern dLLM decoder, six years early.

events.label: XLNet / Levenshtein
events.blurb: Any-order objectives for pretraining; insertion and deletion as generation operations.

events.label: DDPM
events.blurb: The ELBO, noise prediction, and the simple loss that made diffusion practical.

events.label: D3PM
events.blurb: Discrete state-space diffusion; uniform and absorbing kernels; the BERT connection.

events.label: Flow matching
events.blurb: Choose the path, regress the velocity; diffusion becomes a special case.

events.label: Diffusion-LM / SSD-LM
events.blurb: Embedding- and simplex-space text diffusion; SSD-LM already decodes in blocks.

events.label: SEDD
events.blurb: Score entropy brings discrete diffusion to GPT-2-level perplexity.

events.label: MDLM / MD4
events.blurb: The masked objective simplified to weighted cross-entropy; time-independence proven.

events.label: Discrete flow matching
events.blurb: The same masked endpoint re-derived from CTMC velocities; scaled to 1.7B.

events.label: LLaDA / Dream
events.blurb: Masked diffusion at 7-8B matches similarly sized AR models; from scratch and by adaptation.

events.label: Mercury / Seed Diffusion / Gemini Diffusion
events.blurb: Commercial systems serve block-structured diffusion at 1,000+ tokens per second.

events.label: Block Diffusion
events.blurb: BD3-LM makes the AR-diffusion interpolation a trained architecture with an exact block cache.

events.label: RL, safety, hybrids
events.blurb: diffu-GRPO reasoning, mask-infilling jailbreaks, Eso-LM caching: the post-training era begins.
